# Sessions

Trading-session times and days. PowerBridge does not read a session template from your data: most of these return fixed values that describe one session layout, so treat them as placeholders unless your data matches it.

[Back to the keyword reference index](README.md)

### sess1endtime

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

End time of the first session. PowerBridge returns a fixed 1515.

### sessionlastbar

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

True on the last bar of a trading session. PowerBridge decides this from the bar dates: the bar is last when the next bar falls on a new day.

```easylanguage
If SessionLastBar and MarketPosition <> 0 Then Sell Next Bar At Market;
```

### SessionStartDay

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | at least 2 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Weekday (0 = Sunday) on which a session starts, given a session type and number. PowerBridge models sessions 1 to 5 as opening the evening before each weekday and returns 0 for other numbers.
